{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Ravioli|Ravioli]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian cuisine]]

==Ingredients==

*3 large [[Cookbook:Potato|russet potatoes]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*6 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] with a micro plane or finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Chive|chives]], finely [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
*2 tbsp fresh [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the potatoes in their skins until tender when pierced with a fork.
#Peel them as soon as they are cool enough to handle and mash in a bowl.
# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] the garlic in the oil for 1 minute.
#Add the potatoes and mix well.
# Add the chives, lemon juice and seasoning and mix well.
# Cover and allow to cool while you prepare the pasta dough.
